name: Comprehensive Insurance Services
subject: 👀 I made a new homepage for Comprehensive Insurance
body:
Hi team,

I recently worked with Scott Henricks at Unique Risk Management and Insurance Services in Mission Viejo. I designed and developed his website, uniquerisk.com. It is a clean site for an insurance agency, built to explain commercial insurance in simple words and to help visitors ask for a quote with ease.

While looking at insurance businesses in your area, I visited your current website. Your work is strong, you have been helping nonprofits and businesses since 1992, but I noticed a problem on your homepage. Some text on the page does not belong to insurance at all. There are lines about a court case and a money settlement, and a few lines that look like sample text left there by mistake. A new visitor can get confused when they read that.

So I made a new homepage for you. You can see it here:
https://hassanzahhid00.github.io/business-mockups/comprehensive-insurance-lake-forest.html

I used your own logo, your branding and your real details, your Lake Forest address, phone number and email. The new page explains your nonprofit insurance and commercial insurance in clear, simple sections, so a visitor understands what you do in a few seconds.

Please note, this is only the homepage for now. It is a first version to show you the direction. It can definitely be refined. We can change the wording, the photos, the sections or any part of the design, based on what you like. If you like the direction, other pages can also be added, like About, Nonprofit Insurance, Commercial Insurance and a proper Contact page, and it can become your full new website.

Please have a look when you get a minute and tell me what you think. I am happy to make changes, or to talk on a short call, whatever is easy for you.

Thank you for your time.

Best regards,
